name: 07801 · Dover, NJ
findings: ZIP 07801 (Dover) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07801 (Dover) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07801 (Dover) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
